'''big_chief04 Walkers on the plains. No objective pile that has won me a lot of games.''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[big_chief04]]
* '''Published:''' 22 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)|Hoth-D-hothiceplains.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Hoth Ice Plains (5th Marker) big_.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Yes, this deck has done very well for me in some local tournaments and it is a another great drainer like the Dark deal.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Before you activate pull walker garrison and Defensive perimeter with you may start your landing. Pull what ever shields you need.

Early game try and find most of your locations via nemod advisor and set up At-Ats and non battle ground locations to force direct damage of one and walker garrison for 2 more.
That's three damage that the opponent cant even deploy to.  Ghhhk if the opponent beats down on your lone at-ats at non battle ground sites.

Don't usually go to the opponents planet, they will be forced to come to you or face teh walker garrison damage they know is coming.

Secure Hoth with ships and drain for 2 there with chiraneau (4 with walker garrison).

The defensive perimeter and hoth system and my two battlegrounds used to satisfy battle order/plan.

This space force is very good and cheap to deploy, drive them out of space if they play menace fades.  Imperial commands rule space.

The two alters are to protect your walker garrisons from being sensed and cancel annoying goo nee tays and other stuff(mantellian savrip, etc.)

Sense is just a generally useful card, cancel spiral reacting or arconas.

Have fun and merry christmas.
